values.website: An industrial gateway on MediaTek MT7628 with 4G, Wi-Fi 4, RS485, Modbus TCP/RTU, digital/analog I/O, RTC, and SMS remote commands. Designed for field device integration, SCADA connectivity, and industrial alarm and event monitoring.
values.catalogue: An industrial gateway on MediaTek MT7628 with 4G, Wi-Fi 4, RS485, Modbus TCP/RTU, digital/analog I/O, RTC, and SMS remote commands. Designed for field device integration, SCADA connectivity, and industrial alarm and event monitoring.

values.website:
Remote Sensor & Transducer Data to Cloud
Drinking Water Treatment Plant Data to Remote Cloud SCADA
Industrial Alarm & Event Monitoring
values.catalogue:
Remote Sensor & Transducer Data to Cloud — Ideal for connecting Transducers having 4-20mA output and data should be published to remote server using HTTPs/MQTTs communication.
Drinking Water Treatment Plant Data to Remote Cloud SCADA — Ideal for connecting clorine, Turbidity, TDS sensordata etc on AI interface to made available over VPN tunnel in Modbsu to SCADA for monitoring all the treatment paramaters.
Industrial Alarm & Event Monitoring — Suitable for factory alarms, pump stations, and equipment monitoring where digital I/O, pulse input, and SMS-based alerts are required for quick response and uptime management.
